modalities.evidence: This dataset includes T1-weighted and resting-state fMRI scans
T1-weighted and resting-state fMRI scans from idiopathic cervical dystonia patients

output.summary: Structural and resting-state fMRI from idiopathic cervical dystonia patients in a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled pilot trial of continuous theta-burst stimulation to bilateral somatosensory cortex, with clinical rating scales.
